svg.title: Chaos Arena architecture
svg.text: A multiplayer tug-of-war you're allowed to crash, and it heals itself.
HTTPS · HTTP→HTTPS redirect · rate limit 100 req/s
least privilege: one table, one bucket, its own logs
temporary credentials via IMDSv2 · no access keys
a few KB in S3 · logs kept 14 days
git push · pull requests · alert emails
main · pull requests · tags per module
on every push and pull request
